name: @gefi-playground/web
description: Jekyll site for the GeFi Playground (placeholder homepage in Phase 0).

scripts.predev: pnpm --filter @gefi-playground/ui run build:tokens && pnpm run generate:data
scripts.dev: bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle' >/dev/null && bundle install --quiet && bundle exec jekyll serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4000 --livereload --livereload-port 35731
scripts.prebuild: pnpm --filter @gefi-playground/ui run build:tokens && pnpm run generate:data
scripts.build: bundle config set --local path 'vendor/bundle' >/dev/null && bundle install --quiet && bundle exec jekyll build
scripts.test: echo "(web) no JS test suite — Jekyll build is the contract" && exit 0
scripts.typecheck: echo "(web) no TS — skipping typecheck" && exit 0
